about_the_game:
Azur Lane’s very own Admiral Hipper is ready and waiting to join your fleet with a striking permanent camouflage tucked under her arm! The personification of the German heavy cruiser of the same name, she can take command of your German ships and comes with a unique Japanese-language voiceover.

This package includes:

  • German Commander Admiral Hipper with 10 skill points and an individual voiceover

  • 1x "Azur Lane — Siren" permanent camouflage

You can own an unlimited number of copies of Commander Admiral Hipper.

The "Azur Lane — Siren" permanent camouflage can be mounted on any ship. Once mounted, the camouflage is assigned to that ship. You can have an unlimited number of The Azur Lane — Siren permanent camouflages.

This time-limited exclusive DLC is only available until July 2, 2025.
